validation_split: validation (physical parquet mapped to logical test for shared runner)
selection: Evenly spaced nonempty source rows; concatenate subsequent rows with newline until 257 tokens, take first 257. No generated feedback.
method_frozen: Fixed K128 W8A8; no parameter search or fitting on fresh validation split. Previous WikiText test and original authored set are development/regression evidence.

formats.accumulator: actual INT32 partial GEMM, K=128, abs bound 2064512
formats.partial_reduction: FP32 dequantize then sum across K groups
formats.scale: FP32, separate W and A scales for every K group
formats.output: FP16 after FP32 sum and bias
formats.lm_head_embedding_conv: native FP16 matrices/weights excluded from INT8 candidate

scope: Local grouped precision proposal; target integer matrices only, not full integer reduction or full model. Extra group scales/partial sums change hardware budgets.
